$comment: Product version of the Phoenix game build. Governs what is shipped and released; it does not govern wire compatibility or save compatibility. Versioned independently of network_protocol.json and save_schema.json, because the three contracts change at different rates: a product release can ship with an unchanged protocol and an unchanged save schema. See docs/tdd/06-data-schemas.md, 'Independent version lines'. Enforced by tools/validation/validate_versions.py.
